Walnuts are the final touch, offering healthy fats, protein, and a satisfying crunch. These nuts are an excellent source of omega-3 fatty acids, which are beneficial for heart health. These mulberries are then sun-dried to concentrate their natural sweetness and enhance their flavor. This drying process can take several days, depending on the weather conditions, and requires regular turning to ensure even drying and prevent spoilage. The dried mulberries are then ground into a fine powder, which serves as the base for the Walnut Kilao Bar. Honey, another essential ingredient, is gently warmed to a liquid state.
